parameters.query: =WITH assets AS (SELECT value AS asset FROM jsonb_array_elements('{{$json.assets_sql}}'::jsonb) value), inserted AS (INSERT INTO content_assets (job_id,source_type,drive_file_id,file_name,mime_type,file_size_bytes,parse_status,extracted_metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,COALESCE(asset->>'source_type',asset->>'type','drive_file'),asset->>'drive_file_id',COALESCE(asset->>'file_name',asset->>'name','unnamed_asset'),asset->>'mime_type',NULLIF(asset->>'file_size_bytes','')::bigint,'queued',asset FROM assets RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'drive_assets_scanned','Drive assets registered from payload',jsonb_build_object('asset_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM inserted),'credential_ready',true)) SELECT count(*) AS asset_count FROM inserted;
